name: Tyler
biography:
I’m a versatile software developer and frontend designer specializing in building fast, responsive, and dynamic web and mobile applications. I work confidently across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap, combining strong visual design instincts with clean, scalable, and maintainable code.

Backed by a solid object-oriented programming foundation in Java, Python, and C, I develop reliable full-stack features, optimize UI performance across devices, and turn complex requirements into intuitive, user-centered interfaces. My experience spans frontend engineering, backend logic, UI/UX design, and prototyping—supported by tools like Figma, Framer, Bubble.io, Git/GitHub, and modern development workflows.

I thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments where problem-solving, iteration, and communication are essential. Whether coding, designing, or refining user flows, I focus on delivering polished, high-quality experiences that are both functional and visually engaging.
